mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market health that reduces consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad demand contraction that triggers negative equity returns over 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns when their 3-month correlation falls below 0.7.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during supply contraction regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO shows monthly decline.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% consistently lowers equity valuation discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of cases when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Nonfarm payrolls below 140,000 thousand (140 million) indicate labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS is below 140,000 thousand, S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad demand slowdown that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through earnings headwinds.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns when their 3-month correlation is below 0.6.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) weakens consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days during labor market stress regimes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.
